subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 12,000 amounts to Rs. 12,960 at 2% per annum simple interest. Find the duration of the deposit.
solution: Formula: T = SI times 100over P times R SI = A - P Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, T = Time, R = Rate
